nextSteps: Implement fiber_card_eq_crossBall_card (Session 4, ~80-120 lines): For M ≤ n, the filter {y : Fin d → Fin (2n+1) | Σ cweight(yᵢ) ≤ M} bijects with crossBall d M via yᵢ ↦ ⟨(yᵢ).val - (n - M), proof⟩. Use Finset.card_bij with the cweight helpers from Session 3. Prefer `show ... explicit form ...` over `calc` with anonymous Fin literals to avoid metavariable issues.
Implement the slicing: project crossBall (d+1) n on the last coordinate using Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise, identify each fiber with crossBall d (n - δ_j) via fiber_card_eq_crossBall_card.

Implement the j ↔ 2n-j pairing: Σ_{j ∈ Fin (2n+1)} crossEhrhart d (n - δ_j) = crossEhrhart d n + 2·Σ_{m<n} crossEhrhart d m. Convert Fin sum to range sum, split as range n + {n} + (n+1..2n), reverse the high half via Finset.sum_nbij' (m ↦ n - 1 - m).
Switch the main theorem to `induction d generalizing n` so the IH is ∀ n, (crossBall d n).card = crossEhrhart d n. Apply IH and crossEhrhart_succ_d to close.
